openQuestions: Package IDs OfficeIMO.Word.Pdf and OfficeIMO.PowerPoint.Pdf flip direction (PDF->Word reconstruction today, Word->PDF export after). Same NuGet ID with an unrelated API is a silent break for anyone pinning 3.5.x; MIGRATION.md and the release notes must say so explicitly, or the export adapters take new IDs.

Static From{Source} on a type owned by another package (WordDocument.FromHtml in OfficeIMO.Word.Html, WordDocument.FromMarkdown, MarkdownDocument.FromHtml, WordDocument.FromPdf) is only possible with C# 14 static extension members. The SDK supports them for netstandard2.0 targets, but callers on older language versions (.NET Framework projects default to C# 7.3, Windows PowerShell) must call the containing static class directly. Alternative: keep instance forms on the source (pdf.ToWord(), html.ToWordDocument()) as the only adapter shape.

designResolutions.frontDoorTarget: OfficeIMO, its batch engine, OfficeIMO.Workflows and OfficeIMO.Workflows.IWork target netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0, plus net472 through the existing Windows-only project condition (approved c526a10ad2). Modern-only route engines are conditionally referenced and registered.
designResolutions.frameworks: Superseded by the approved c526a10ad2 design: retain netstandard2.0, net8.0, net10.0 and the original Windows-only net472 declaration; modern-only packages retain their original targets. Front door and Workflows gain the full set, with explicitly conditional modern engines.

phaseA.scope: Package boundaries, target frameworks, lifecycle, options, conversions and names.

extraChanges.subject: Native chart diagnostic split
extraChanges.note: Successful native 3D groups emit chart-flattened; other approximated chart structures retain native-body-chart-simplified. Projection warnings also cover the shared chart snapshot path.

extraChanges.subject: Completed PDF model conversion evidence
extraChanges.note: ToPdf renders and reopens a private artifact before returning its shared report, so writer-time findings, page counts and FailOnLoss are complete. It returns the original authoring model so callers can continue editing; subsequent native saves retain the normal AllowLoss policy.

extraChanges.change: Dispose temporary PDF models after SaveAsPdf and failed ToPdf completion; successful ToPdf retains the authored model for subsequent composition.
extraChanges.reason: The unified IDisposable lifecycle transfers ownership only for returned models. Writer-time findings must complete before the public report is returned.

extraChanges.note: Removed the now-unused LegacyDocPdfConverter facade. Normal Word Load plus source SaveAsPdf handles live models; OfficeConverter combines import and render findings. The legacy conversion tests now exercise the public front door, explicit load-loss rejection and exact output preservation.

extraChanges.reason: The approved format-prefix and read-only Info rules also apply to these public option, asset and page-scene types.

extraChanges.note: Async conversion entry points capture options before deferred work or resource awaits. The same snapshot supplies resource/size limits and final FailOnLoss acceptance; caller-owned template documents and callbacks retain their ownership.

Strict adapter PDF saves use the existing staged writer with shared report acceptance before publication. Source-stage and writer-time losses throw OfficeConversionException carrying OfficeConversionReport; native advanced result policies keep their existing behavior. The same writer and file/stream publication owners are reused. Front-door HTML/TXT saves dispose the generated model.

Canonical PDF export validates destination arguments before conversion. Later serialization and publication failures retain completed evidence; malformed destination arguments keep their ordinary argument exceptions.

InternalsVisibleTo grants the existing browser engine and its tests access to detailed conversion and serialization evidence. This preserves browser diagnostics while keeping conversion kernels outside the public API.

extraChanges.change: Word page images expose options-based ToImage/ToImageAsync, SaveAsImage/SaveAsImageAsync and aggregate SaveAsImages/SaveAsImagesAsync. Rendering kernels and snapshot reading remain on the existing Word adapter.
extraChanges.reason: The Word map image entries apply to the forward Word.Pdf adapter after the Phase A package move.

extraChanges.change: The Word image cmdlet keeps its existing detailed PassThru values through an internal SaveImageResults operation and friend access. The public save API returns only OfficeConversionReport. Sync image conversion/saving accepts cancellation, and the out-report form follows the options-then-report order used by the PDF/HTML/Markdown adapters.
extraChanges.reason: Mechanical consumer closure and shared-owner preservation for the approved API change.

questionResolutions.conversionForms: Source.ToTarget, source.SaveAsTarget and OfficeConversionReport; async ToTarget returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. ToHtml returns string. No static From factories.
questionResolutions.frameworks: No framework is dropped in 3.6. Original library TFMs and Windows net472 conditions remain; the front door and both Workflows projects support the full set. Modern-only engines stay conditional.
questionResolutions.packageDirection: Word.Pdf and PowerPoint.Pdf export native documents. Reverse reconstruction is Pdf.Word and Pdf.PowerPoint; Excel reconstruction is Pdf.Excel. Word page images live in Word.Pdf.
questionResolutions.surface: Markdown syntax nodes are exempt from the format prefix. OfficeColor/OfficeColorRole use the root OfficeIMO namespace. Authoring, units, image-builder consolidation, visibility baselines and AOT smoke acceptance are Phase B.
